newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chilean supermarkets started. [CORRECTED 15:04 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chilean supermarkets started. [CORRECTED 15:04 GMT]

text.p: HSBC James Capel started coverage of Chilean supermarket chain D&S SA Tuesday with a rating of buy.
-- The firm also rated chains Santa Isabel SA and Supermercados Unimarc sells.
-- HSBC James Capel set a target price of 475 pesos for D&S shares. They closed Monday at 442.50.
-- It set a target price of $14.50 for Unimarc American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), which were up 1/8 at $18-7/8 in New York.
-- It set a target price of $27.50 (corrects price from $31.50) for Santa Isabel ADRs.
They were trading down 1/4 at 32 in New York.
